description: This Java source file defines a servlet filter class 'FineractInstanceModeApiFilter' which manages request filtering based on the instance mode and request path, primarily controlling access and behavior in different modes of the Fineract application.

classes.name: FineractInstanceModeApiFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that enforces access control based on the application's instance mode and request path. It allows or rejects requests accordingly, primarily used for managing read-only or operational modes in the application.

classes.name: ExceptionListItem
classes.description: A nested static class used to encapsulate conditions (mode and path predicates) for requests that are exceptions to the default filtering rules.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Overrides the method to perform filtering logic, deciding whether to proceed or reject a request based on instance mode and request path.

methods.name: isActuatorApi
methods.description: Checks if the request is targeting the actuator API endpoints.

methods.name: proceed
methods.description: Continues the filter chain, allowing the request to be processed further.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects a request by setting a 405 Method Not Allowed response and sending an error message.

methods.name: isPathOnExceptionList
methods.description: Determines if the request path matches any of the exception list paths.

methods.name: isOnExceptionList
methods.description: Checks whether the request matches any exception path conditioned on current mode settings.

methods.name: isReadMethod
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP method of the request is GET.
